title: displaying the battery status of the master device on the follower device...
symptom: The user requests the ability to see the battery status of the master device on the follower device via xDrip Cloud, as their daughter often forgets to charge her phone. They ask if it can be implemented in the Classic Status Page tab, with a suggested update periodicity of 15 minutes.
fix: The feature works when 'Engineering mode' is enabled. A pull request (PR #3803) was mentioned to allow disabling engineering mode after the feature is available. The xDrip sync follower shows the master phone battery level as of the 2024.12.17 release.
evidence_quote: After turning on the "Engineering mode", I also got a display of the battery level of the master device.
